title: Crossing the Red Sea! 🌊 Moses and God's Mighty Power | Bible Lesson for Kids | Sunday School
top:
A giant wall of water on this side, a giant wall of water on that side, and a dry path right in the middle! 🌊 How did that happen? Join us for the amazing story of Moses and the crossing of the Red Sea from Exodus 14.

God's people were slaves in Egypt, and God sent Moses to tell Pharaoh, "Let My people go!" When Pharaoh's army chased them to the sea, Moses said, "Do not be afraid! The Lord will fight for you." God split the sea, and His people walked through on dry ground. Then Miriam played her tambourine and everyone sang, "Praise be to God!" 🎶

📖 Memory verse: "So the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea on the dry ground." (Exodus 14:22)
🎯 Lesson: God takes care of us. We can trust Him when we are scared, and always say thank You!
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.
